title: No Solution or Infinitely Many | Algebra I, Unit 2, Lesson 4
description:
Some equations have no solution and some have infinitely many. Learn to tell them apart by simplifying until x disappears, and see why on a graph: parallel lines never meet, and identical lines meet everywhere. Ends with a practice problem.
